name: Performance Grapher for Stream Deck
headline: See What Your PC Did, Not Just What It's Doing Right Now
description:
Performance Grapher for Stream Deck gives Windows gamers rolling PC performance history for FPS drops, frametime spikes, temperatures, load, power, and RAM. Five readable keypad actions cover graphs, Game FPS, session summaries, sensors, and threshold alerts.

New in 1.1: Stream Deck Neo owners can add a dedicated Infobar action instead of spending a normal key. The default Infobar shows CPU / GPU / RAM at a glance; Single Metric adds a larger selected reading with an optional 60-second trend, and Rotating Metrics cycles a compact selected set. It reuses the same shared local telemetry and bounded history as the normal keys.

Performance Grapher uses PresentMon for local frame timing and Libre Hardware Monitor for supported sensors. Common metrics appear first, with raw hardware sensors available behind Show advanced sensors. CPU and RAM remain available when advanced hardware sensors are unavailable.

Game FPS may need a one-time Windows permission. Click Enable Game FPS, approve the prompt, then sign out and back in once. No paid sensor app, API key, account, cloud service, or screen scraping is required.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 7.6 or newer. Sensor availability varies by hardware and driver support. History is bounded and stored locally on your PC.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Adds a dedicated Stream Deck Neo Infobar action with CPU / GPU / RAM overview.
- Adds Single Metric and Rotating Metrics Infobar modes with optional 60-second trends.
- Moves to Elgato Stream Deck SDK 3.0 while preserving existing keypad actions, profiles, and local telemetry.
- Keeps Neo updates on the existing shared polling/history engine with no extra hardware or FPS process.
